source.note: Internet Archive classical music collection — smaller than grateful-dead's, same schema

organs.determiners: injected — priors.js DEFINITE_DETERMINERS + INDEFINITE_DETERMINERS (giver lang/en, P41)
organs.posPriorGate: active — native/priors/pos-eng.json (giver: Universal Dependencies — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_English-EWT/master/en_ewt-ud-train.conllu (train split), human-annotated gold treebank) gates relations.js::discoverRelationVocab's candidate verb vocabulary
organs.classifyConnector: wordclass.js dominantClass (giver: Universal Dependencies — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_English-EWT/master/en_ewt-ud-train.conllu (train split), human-annotated gold treebank) — minShare 0.5, per-EDGE DISCLOSURE ONLY, never gates admission (see posPriorGate above for the vocabulary-level gate, which is a different mechanism and IS active)
organs.verbForms: omitted — opt-in only, undecided default per the-fold CLAUDE.md
organs.createLemmatizer: active — native/priors/morphology-eng.json (giver UniMorph), widens verb equality to sameAct (e.g. "underwent"≈"undergoes") — MINE-1 measured: bound 531→536, zero contradictions
organs.sameStem: omitted — no declension prior for language "en" in this environment
